body.content: Counterfactual test: If the problem were 'What is 15% of 80 over 2 periods?' the answer would be 80 × 1.15^2 = 105.8, not 12. This confirms that the standard result 12 relies on the implicit assumption of a single linear application of the percentage, as no compounding or time dimension is stated. The covering principle here is the linearity of single-step scaling.
body.possible_next_move: Test if any non-linear interpretation of the problem text could be validly inferred, or if the linear reading is the only admissible one.
